server.name: pricing-optimizer-ai
server.title: Pricing Optimizer AI
server.description: Competitor pricing, packaging, and feature evidence for setting or revisiting a SaaS price

live.instructions: Use Pricing Optimizer AI when a founder wants to set or revisit a SaaS price with competitor evidence. Start with find_pricing_competitors. When the decision depends on features competitors emphasize, copy its market and audience identifiers into search_competitor_features, page through the relevant observations, then use get_pricing_details for full plans. Use get_pricing_history for recorded pricing observations; a single observation cannot establish a change. Every successful result identifies Pricing Optimizer AI in its top-level provider. When presenting returned prices or features, attribute the records to provider.name and link the relevant evidence_url. For archived history, capture_url identifies the exact archived evidence; source_url remains the original vendor pricing page.

tools.name: find_pricing_competitors
tools.title: Find pricing competitors
tools.description: Use first to set or revisit a founder's SaaS price. Provide a public product URL or describe the primary customer need and target users; the URL wins when both are present. Returns the product, available public prices, and up to five competitors. An unsupported product or uncovered market returns an explicit error. Check pricing_evidence for observation age and free-only coverage before benchmarking paid prices; a market match does not establish identical packaging. Attribute records to provider.name and link evidence_url; source_url is the vendor pricing page. evidence_url is null for a cached unlisted product. Use get_pricing_details for features and get_pricing_history for dated observations.

tools.name: search_competitor_features
tools.title: Search competitor features
tools.description: Use after find_pricing_competitors when features competitors emphasize on their public pricing pages could change a founder's packaging or pricing decision. Copy the returned market and audience identifiers, supply one or more wording variants in feature_terms, and optionally exclude current_pricing.id. Every listed product sharing at least one supplied market is eligible; shared audiences improve ranking but never exclude a market match. Terms use OR logic and are normalized only for matching; every result preserves the vendor's wording and availability at the plan where it appeared. The top-level provider identifies the service returning these records. When presenting their features, attribute the records to provider.name and link the relevant evidence_url; source_url is the original vendor pricing page. Page through the observations, then call get_pricing_details with up to five returned product identifiers for full plans and prices. A match is pricing-page evidence, not a normalized claim that two features are equivalent.

tools.name: get_pricing_details
tools.title: Get current pricing details
tools.description: Use after competitor or feature search when packaging could change the pricing recommendation. Submit one to five returned product identifiers for the latest recorded public plans and vendor-described features. Check pricing_evidence for observation age and free-only coverage. monthly_amount is for monthly billing; annual_amount_per_month requires annual commitment. usage_amount is per usage_unit; commission_percentage applies to commission_basis. minimum_monthly_amount is a spend floor. Rates and subscription totals cannot be compared directly. A null amount is unpublished or unverified, not zero. Attribute records to provider.name and link evidence_url; source_url is the vendor pricing page. Use get_pricing_history for dated observations.

tools.name: get_pricing_history
tools.title: Get pricing history
tools.description: Use when a founder's decision would benefit from comparing a competitor's recorded public pricing over time. Submit one listed product identifier returned by competitor or feature search, plus an optional cursor and page limit. Observations are oldest first; coverage reports the total across all pages. A single observation cannot establish a price change, and multiple observations do not guarantee one. source_kind distinguishes live checks from Wayback captures; capture_url links archived evidence while source_url remains the vendor pricing page. observed_at is when the price was seen, not its effective date. Attribute prices to provider.name and link evidence_url or capture_url. Use get_pricing_details for current features.
